notes.title: About bug report/ask/guide
notes.content:
Hello, this is Milky from Milky Factory.

I have noticed that some of the player want to
report bug or ask me questions about the game-play,
or want an actual guide-line with achievements & endings.

If you have any questions or need help,
discord(milkyfactory) is the fastest way to contact me.
or you can give me email(milkkkiss@naver.com),
otherwise you can dm/mention me on X(milky_factory).

If you need a guide, there's a notion page on homepage link.
It is written in Korean, but I'll consider translating it if anyone wants it.

I am terribly sorry for leaving this game so unattended.
I can't get an alarm from steam forum or community,
so please contact me directly if you need any help.

Thank you so much for your attention and love for Demonophobia Company.
I'll do my best on my next game.

Much love,
- Milky Factory
